description: S7 page gaps. Diagnosis only: which captured kemira.com pages would settle which unresolved claims, and what each page's opening does. The site-wide structural diagnosis applies equally to every captured page and is stated once; it does not differentiate pages.

site_wide.statement: No captured page carries Organization or Corporation schema. All 21 captured HTML pages carry the same default schema set (WebPage, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, ListItem, SearchAction, ReadAction, EntryPoint, PropertyValueSpecification; ImageObject on some).
Only one captured page (S19, the investor FAQ) has an FAQ block, and it carries no FAQPage markup. S19 is never cited by any assistant.

19 of 21 captured HTML pages have no h1 element. The homepage has four, all carousel slides (the first is 'Introducing KemAlpha renewable polymers'); only /water/wastewater has a single page-title h1.

S01.question: What is Kemira?
S01.reason: After a 'Company' label and 'About us' heading, the first paragraph answers directly ('Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water-intensive industries...').

S02.question: What is Kemira?
S02.reason: Opens with a promotional carousel (KemAlpha launch, REPUR acquisition, interim report), then a generic line ('in the business of chemistry expertise'); the identity statement comes third.

S03.question: What is Kemira's strategy and business model?
S03.reason: Opens with a date (5/29/2026), then aspirational framing ('Clean water, sanitation, and the smart use of limited resources are key components of quality of life'); the strategy is not stated in the first blocks.

S04.question: What are Kemira's business units and markets?
S04.reason: Opens with a date (5/29/2026); the first paragraph describes the focus areas in general terms but does not name the three business units.

S05.reason: Opens with a date (7/17/2026) followed by two headings; no outlook or target is stated in the first blocks.

S06.reason: Opens with the customer's problem (tightening regulation, megatrends); the offering follows only generically ('a range of innovative solutions'), with no products named.

S07.question: What does Kemira offer for wastewater treatment?
S07.reason: Opens with general statements about chemical treatment ('has been around for a long time... safe, reliable and cost-effective'); Kemira's own offering is not stated in the first blocks.

S08.reason: Opens with general freshwater facts ('Less than 3% of all water on earth is freshwater...'); Kemira's offering appears only in general terms in the third block.

S09.reason: Opens with the problem ('Sludge dewatering can be a tricky operation'), then a generic offering ('Our complete product portfolio and deep knowledge...'); no products, outcomes or figures in the first blocks.
